Name: Chat window customizer
Author: HitaxasTV
Description:
[b]What this mod allows you to do[/b]:
[*]Recolor the chat history background and set its transparency, with an optional "decorative border" (The game's default background texture).[/*]
[*]Recolor chat text on its own, add bold and a drop shadow, and scale the text size up or down.[/*]
[*]Recolor the entry box you type in completely separate from the chat history. With its own background color, text color, bold, shadow, and font. [/*]
[*]Swap the game's built in pixel font for any font installed on your PC, with the same bold/shadow/color options (See note below).[/*]
[*]Click anywhere in your message to place the text caret (the blinking thing), or click and drag / Shift+click to select text, like any normal text box.[/*]
[*]The shortcuts you should already know: Ctrl+A select all, Ctrl+C/X/V copy/cut/paste, Ctrl+Z undo.[/*]
[*]Arrow keys, Home/End, and Ctrl+Arrow to jump word by word[/*]
[*]Ctrl+Z brings back anything removed by a paste, a cut, or deleting a selection[/*]
[*]Utilize custom emojis! Press the -> arrow on the bottom right of the emoji menu to swap to the custom emojis page[/*]
[*]Add your own custom emojis! Supports community made packs using an easy to follow format. 


[b]Note[/b]: System font support only functions on Windows devices (uses System.Drawing for this). Keyboard shortcuts were built with Windows in mind as well. Support for other platforms is not being considered at this time, so if something doesn't work for them, sorry.

[b]Feel free to check out my other mods[/b]:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51350]Prismatic Paxel[/url] -  Adds a prismatic tier multi-tool that can act as a pickaxe, axe or hoe
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24071]Bugs in the valley[/url] - Adds forageable bugs that can be turned into the museum
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51846]Sen's Pokemon partner[/url] - Adds a pokémon partner for Sen from Lurking in the Dark, for Pelipper Town
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24305]Item Checker[/url] - Adds a simple UI to help find where an item is, also a utility for mod authors

[size=1]Hey, you: please endorse the mod if you like it. More people might see it, and that'd be pretty awesome.[/size]
